_note: Manual per-beat flags, editable by hand and merged into grammar/picks.json at ingest. Separate from the review UI so a flag can be set without running a review pass, and so flags survive a UI rebuild. Beat keys are passage-beat, e.g. 17-17.

_flags.needsTextTemplate: the beat wants an on-screen text or question treatment. Three text templates are unprocessed as of 2026-09-21; this records where they go.
_flags.rawBroll: the beat wants sourced footage. Admits match-cut vessels across jobs. Also settable in the review UI.
_flags.contentClass: the beat declares a content class, which admits the templates SCOPE.md restricts to it. Scoped templates are bound to no job, so this is their only route into a slate. Set by hand; user decision, like rawBroll.
_flags.wantsMediaKind: What KIND of media this beat's slots should take — person, footage, document, artwork, graphic. DECLARED, never extracted: the narration does not say it. Two extraction methods were built and measured against the user's own answers (LOG 0098): a 633-title work gazetteer found ONE true positive across 40 beats and any noise guard killed it; a work-noun signal hit 100% recall at 20% precision, because the whole script is about a catalog. The beat says "Big back catalog"; deciding that album covers serve it is TASTE. Ranks, never excludes, like every other kind signal.

Pass-1 note: "horrible first selections. a slideshow should house the mixtape covers, a b-roll match cut of YouTube video screenshots could handle the features." A/B note, both arms, zero selections: "neither... needs something that can shows mixtapes, jetLife and features".
02-02b.reasoning: The beat has TWO requirements and the beat record holds one. must_be_perceptible captured the RELATION — `magnitude`, the two catalogs reading as roughly equal. The user's notes are about the CONTENT — mixtape covers, Jet Life, features, which are specific real things that must appear on screen. Nothing in the beat record has a field for that; rawBroll is the flag that already exists for it, and the user's own words name a match cut. This is the mechanism as designed, not a new one.
